description: Structural shape of a hook-wire-v1 <case>.input.json fixture (spec 08 -> Hook normalization and output adapters). Deliberately loose on field values: the 'malformed' case fixtures are well-formed JSON with wrong-typed/unknown values by design, and must still validate structurally here — value-level policy validation (trigger enum, command string type, session_id charset) is the hook's own runtime concern, not this schema's.
